summary: Attempted frontend testing of new EMR features: Saved Forms section and Documents tab. Could not complete comprehensive testing due to persistent session management issues causing frequent redirects to login page.

critical_bugs.issue: Session expires immediately or redirects to login page after successful authentication
critical_bugs.impact: Prevents sustained frontend testing and user workflow completion

integration_issues.issue: Authenticated users get redirected to login page during navigation
affected_selectors: Login redirects prevent access to main application

passed_tests: Login form displays correctly with email and password fields
Initial dashboard loads briefly after login
Patients list is accessible and shows existing patients
Code review confirms proper implementation of Saved Forms section in VisitDetailPage.js
Code review confirms proper implementation of Documents tab in PatientProfilePage.js

success_percentage.backend: 20% - Login authentication works but session management fails
success_percentage.frontend: 30% - UI elements load but cannot test workflows due to session issues

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix session management/authentication system. Users cannot maintain logged-in state - gets redirected to login page immediately after authentication. This prevents testing of new features (Saved Forms section and Documents tab) and normal application workflow. Backend session handling or frontend token management needs investigation.
